form:HelpHTML.p: The API Key will have the same permissions as the owner of the key.
Anyone in possession of the API Key will be able to perform any action that the owner can.

form:FormGroup.label: API Key Name
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Must be unique for this owner.

form:HelpHTML.p: A name for the API Key. This can be used to describe the intended purpose of the key.
API Key names must be unique for the same owner.

form:FormGroup.label: Hash Algorithm
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: SHA options are fast; BCrypt and Argon2 add about 100 ms per call.

form:HelpHTML.p: The hashing algorithm used to hash the API Key for storage in Stroom (Stroom only stores a hash of the key and its prefix, not the full key).
Different algorithms offer different security/performance characteristics.

The SHA algorithms provide less of a performance impact on the API. BCrypt and Argon2 are potentially more secure (though this is marginal given the size of the API Keys) but have an overhead of ~100ms on API calls.

form:FormGroup.label: API Key Prefix
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Read only. Matches the start of the key you hold.

form:HelpHTML.p: This is the key's prefix. It can be used to help associate a key that you hold with the API key record in Stroom. Note: though unlikely, multiple keys can share the same prefix.

form:FormGroup.label: API Key (you must copy this)
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Copy it now. It cannot be shown again.

form:HelpHTML.p: This is the full API Key. Because it is never stored in Stroom you must copy it now for use in your client application/script. Once you close this dialog, Stroom will never be able to show you this key again.
To use the API Key in your client application or script, set a HTTP header with key 'Authorization' and value 'Bearer ${TOKEN}' (where '${TOKEN}' is the full API Key, e.g.

form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Unticked keys cannot be used to authenticate.

form:HelpHTML.p: You can temporarily disable a key which will prevent anyone from authenticating with that key.
Comments can be added to help describe the purpose of the key.

form:FormGroup.label: Expiry Date
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Must be in the future, within the maximum age (365 days by default).

form:HelpHTML.p: This is the expiry date of the key. After this date, the API Key will no longer be allowed to authenticate and will be essentially useless.
